name: The Mighty Claw
detailed_description:
Unleash Your Creativity


[ different solutions to the same spot (fw2 or the Mw5 bonus item?), gifs side by side]

In The Mighty Claw, creativity is your greatest asset. Explore an environment that encourages you to discover dozens of unique ways to use your Claw. Whether it’s building speed, swinging across wide gaps, chaining together moves, tossing enemies, or stretching gigantic guinea pigs by pulling their bottoms, the Claw is the ultimate tool at your disposal!

With so much flexibility, you can forge your own path through each level. There’s no single solution to any obstacle—experiment, get creative, and find your own style of play!

Endless Things to Claw Onto


[show vines, conveyors, spinners, enemy grabbing]

Target anything and everything—walls, ceilings, mad scientist owls, or tornadoes sneezed from a congested nose. From vines and conveyors to spinners and unsuspecting enemies, there’s no shortage of things to latch onto with your Claw. Every target offers a unique interaction, making the Claw the ultimate multi-tool for any situation!

Master the Art of Grappling


Master your movement by combining grappling with a versatile set of skills. Push off walls and ceilings to gain momentum and speed instantly, or use your jet shoes to slow your descent, hover over gaps, and perfect your aim.

A Wild and Wacky World Awaits You


Dive into the colorful and whimsical world of The Mighty Claw, teeming with quirky surprises and a cast of eccentric characters. When a megalomaniac conqueror invades the village of our young hero—along with his chronically bored pet elephant and an army of [s]fearsome[/s]completely incompetent troops—it’s up to you to rise to the challenge.

Armed with the mysterious Claw, our hero sets off on a journey to liberate the lands from this absurd invader’s clutches. Along the way, enjoy a captivating soundtrack by award-winning composer Richard Hunter, making every swing of your Claw even more epic.

  • Coming soon: difficulties and special modes suitable for all kinds players

short_description: The Mighty Claw is a 2D grappling hook platformer where your creativity knows no limits: Attach your grapple to terrain, conveyor belts, chronically bored pet elephants, and more! Explore a vibrant cartoon world filled with swinging, spinning, grabbing, and throwing!
